title: Release check · Example shop
intro: Open each page, check the item and write a note.

items.title: Product grid at small widths
items.text: The grid now uses 2 columns below 640 px. Check that the cards do not overflow.
items.q: Is 2 columns OK on small phones?
items.note: The sale page has fewer products in the test data.

items.title: Footer links on wide screens
items.text: The footer links stop at the content width now.

items.title: Cart badge count
items.text: The badge shows the number of line items, not the quantity.

items.title: Search box focus ring
items.text: The focus ring is 2 px orange, matching the brand colour.
items.q: Is the contrast OK on the dark header?
items.note: WCAG 2.2 asks for 3:1 against the neighbours.

items.title: Price with VAT toggle
items.text: The toggle keeps its state in the URL as `?vat=incl`.

items.title: Checkout step bar
items.text: The step bar collapses to numbers only below 480 px.

items.title: Empty cart page
items.text: The empty cart shows three suggested products.
items.q: Keep suggestions, or a plain message?

items.title: Language switch
items.text: The switch is now a `<select>` in the header.
items.note: Only two languages ship in v1.

items.title: Order confirmation mail preview
items.text: The preview page renders the mail template with test data.
items.q: Does the layout hold in the preview?

items.title: Product image zoom
items.text: Hover zooms the image 2x on desktop. Touch opens a full-screen view.

items.title: Filter sidebar on tablet
items.text: The filters fold into a drawer between 640 and 1024 px.

items.title: Stock warning text
items.text: Products with fewer than 5 items show `Only N left`.
where: stock is 4 in the test data

items.title: Newsletter form error
items.text: An invalid mail shows the error under the field, not as an alert.

items.title: Print styles for the order page
items.text: The order page prints without header, footer and buttons.
items.q: Good enough for a packing slip?
items.note: The logo is an SVG and prints fine, but takes a line.

items.title: 404 page
items.text: The 404 page links to the home page and the search.
items.q: Keep the search box on it?
